AnchorLink.description: An anchor at a doc line's end, with where it opens; none for one that names no record.
AnchorLink.title: AnchorLink

Body.description:
A write's or a save's JSON body: one op of a batch's (DR-0639), the items it acts on and that op's keys. `items`
holds one ref, or the ticked rows of a bulk; `bulk` says the act bar sent it, so one ticked row runs as a bulk too.
`at` names the row the selection goes to after a call, which the answer gives back. A point op names its meeting
in `items`, its point by id in `point`, and a removal its points in `points` (DR-0667, DR-0770).
Body.title: Body

Button.description:
A verdict's button, with the key that presses it. It carries what it writes, decided before the post by the old
tasks app's bulk rule: `writes` is its verdict, or None when every row it acts on holds it already, so pressing it
again clears it and no write toggles (DR-0710).
Button.title: Button

Chip.description: A state the list shows: open, snoozed, closed or all, with how many items it holds.
Chip.title: Chip

Chosen.description: A filter or a boost the search holds, with the same search without it.
Chosen.title: Chosen

CitedLine.description: A doc line the open line was built from, as it reads now, with its own raw.
CitedLine.title: CitedLine

Classify.description:
Work or private on a staged record: its key, what is checked on it and typed, as the URL holds them (`u` and
`line` each a number from 1 or a range, `cut` as --cut takes it), and what the panel showed of it.
Classify.title: Classify

CurateDecide.description: Accept, reject or edit one card, at the round and the entity file's hash the page showed it with.
CurateDecide.title: CurateDecide

CutBefore.description: The version in raw that was cut before: its run and its text.
CutBefore.title: CutBefore

DayMeetingLine.description:
A meeting of the day: its line as Meetings shows it, where and with whom, and its prep, the open points and the
open items on it, each to the count the list shows and how many more.
DayMeetingLine.title: DayMeetingLine

Decide.description: A pick on a waiting decision: the page's brief, the decision, the rev the page showed and the pick.
Decide.title: Decide

EditForm.description:
The edit form as the card proposes it: for a new card its type, id, a name per language and role; the
spellings to keep, each plain or asr.
EditForm.title: EditForm

EditName.description: A new card's name in one of the owner's languages.
EditName.title: EditName

Edited.description:
A card as the edit form says: the spellings kept, by their place, each plain or asr; for a new card its type,
id, a name per language and role. The spellings left out are rejected as its aliases (DR-0461).
Edited.title: Edited

Filters.description: The list's own filters as the canonical URL holds them, for the page's filter bar.
Filters.title: Filters

ItemPanel.description:
An item as its panel shows it (DR-0664): its call, its fields, the meeting it hangs on, its free text, its
materials, where it came from, its counts and its history.
ItemPanel.title: ItemPanel

Lead.description: The next meeting: under way now, or the first still to start today, else the next working day's first.
Lead.title: Lead

Ledger.description: The Ledger's list (DR-0666), as the page shows it, with what its bars need.
Ledger.title: Ledger

Link.description:
A material or a source as the panel links it (DR-0664): a URL, a record's raw on the Search page, a recording
at its time, a text locator as a search, or a path from the host repo's top that opens through the service, a text
file in the panel's viewer too.
Link.title: Link

Linked.description: An item on the meeting, or one worth raising there with why, and its panel on the Ledger.
Linked.title: Linked

MeasureRow.description: A kind of question, its recall at 10 and MRR before the round and after its last card.
MeasureRow.title: MeasureRow

MeetingLine.description: A meeting as the list reads at a glance: its time, subject and badge, its points and its open items.
MeetingLine.title: MeetingLine

MeetingPanel.description:
A meeting as its panel shows it (DR-0667): when and where, who, the recording, the talking points, the outcome
and notes, its items, the suggestions when asked, its materials and its history.
MeetingPanel.title: MeetingPanel

Meetings.description: Meetings' list (DR-0666, DR-0768): the meetings by day, with what its bars need.
Meetings.title: Meetings

Missing.description: An open key nothing is staged under any more.
Missing.title: Missing

Notice.description: What the last write did (DR-0710): its words, the batch's lines, and Undo or Redo by its batch.
Notice.title: Notice

PairRow.description: One stretch of time: the recorder's lines in it, and Whisper's whose middle falls in them.
PairRow.title: PairRow

Piece.description: A stretch of a snippet's text, marked when it is one of the query's words.
Piece.title: Piece

PointLine.description: A talking point as the panel shows it, named by its id, never its n (DR-0667).
PointLine.title: PointLine

Prep.description: An open talking point as the list shows it: read only, its buttons on the meeting's panel.
Prep.title: Prep

Promote.description: One source's ready records, or every source's when `source` is null.
Promote.title: Promote

Queue.description:
The Queue's list (DR-0666), in the Ledger's shape: its groups by call, no state chips, and the Ledger's own
filters, state, group and archived, at their defaults.
Queue.title: Queue

ReadyCount.description: A source with records ready to promote, and how many.
ReadyCount.title: ReadyCount

Refused.description:
Why a read or a write was refused, in the writer's or the reader's own words; an add refused as a look-alike
names the open items it looks like, so the page can offer Add anyway (DR-0710).
Refused.title: Refused

Round.description: A new round: nothing to say but that it is asked for.
Round.title: Round

Row.description: A row of the list: an item as it reads at a glance, with its quick buttons when a call takes it.
Row.title: Row

Saved.description:
A field saved: the item's row and panel after it, and the versions before and after its write (DR-0710). A
page whose read had `before` refetches nothing else; one whose read is older missed a write from the CLI, Claude
or a sync while the poll held for the field, and refetches its reads.
Saved.title: Saved

SavedMeeting.description:
A meeting's outcome or notes saved: its line and panel after it, and the versions before and after its write,
as `Saved` answers them for an item (DR-0710, DR-0770).
SavedMeeting.title: SavedMeeting

SearchRead.description: The results the Search page lists for its URL, with what the start and the waiting state say.
SearchRead.title: SearchRead

Seen.description:
What a panel showed of a staged record: its state, who classified it and its cuts, posted back with a
classification so a change since is caught (DR-0785).
Seen.title: Seen

Shell.description:
What the sidebar shows beside its pages (DR-0708): the counts and marks, and the vault, machine and index line
at its foot. A count is None when its part of the vault doesn't read; `problem` says why the vault doesn't open.
Shell.title: Shell

Snooze.description: A snooze choice: the day it snoozes to, and how its button reads.
Snooze.title: Snooze

SummaryLink.description: The doc that summarises a group, opened beside the results.
SummaryLink.title: SummaryLink

SyncLine.description:
A live source's last sync: when, in words that never count down, and whether it is due one, as the sidebar's
Sync mark says (DR-0304); one with a run open is syncing, never due.
SyncLine.title: SyncLine

Today.description:
Today's list (DR-0773): the next meeting with its prep, the items due, the rest of the day's meetings, the
items closed today and the last sync per source, with what the act bar and the panels need.
Today.title: Today

TodayPanel.description: Today's panel: the item's, as the Ledger's, or the meeting's, as Meetings', whichever `open` names.
TodayPanel.title: TodayPanel

TranscriptPair.description: The recorder's transcript and Whisper's side by side, aligned by time (DR-0570).
TranscriptPair.title: TranscriptPair

TypeChoice.description: A tab narrowing the list to one entity type, or to every brief; `name` is "All" for every brief.
TypeChoice.title: TypeChoice

Unfilled.description: A placeholder a command keeps, and the value it stands for: one a shell would act on.
Unfilled.title: Unfilled

VerifiedLine.description: A summary line beside the raw its anchors point at; flagged when they don't all resolve.
VerifiedLine.title: VerifiedLine

Wrote.description:
What a write did: its notice, with Undo or Redo by its batch, the rows a bulk skipped, where the selection goes,
an add's new item, and the version under the write's own lock, so the page's poll doesn't refetch for it.
Wrote.title: Wrote

schema.title: Response Ledger Save Api Web Ledger Save Post
